title: Support email is not found!
body:
Hello
Does any one know how to contact the developers of AAPS? 
the link to get help is: 
https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/GettingHelp/WhereCanIGetHelp.html#i-m-getting-stuck-what-do-i-do-who-can-i-ask

however, The provided email there, developers@androidaps.org doesn't exist and returns an "address not found massage"
Is there any typo mistake?

comments.body: You can go to Facebook group or Discord group and ask your questions there... There are exact steps what to do in document you are referring to. You can't just skip first 4 steps because you don't like them.

Thank Go-d that due to my religious guidelines I don't really have
Social media... So I guess that my only way is through the email
